android.//: Pinned so @capgo/capacitor-social-login (iOS-only, added purely to dodge the GoogleSignIn/ML Kit pod clash) cannot join the Android build. Without this list Android would silently inherit it and Gradle would resolve play-services-auth up from the 18.x the google-auth plugin asks for to 21.4.0 — an unreviewed change to a shipped Pro feature. Guarded by an e2e check: adding a plugin dependency without listing it here (or in the iOS list) fails the suite.

ios.//: No third-party ML Kit plugin on either platform since 1.68.1: iOS uses Apple Vision and Android uses Play Services unbundled ML Kit v2 (Latin + Chinese), both via DuitfulKit.recognizeText. The capacitor:copy:after hook (scripts/trim-native-web.mjs) leaves Tesseract out of the iOS web bundle while Android keeps it as an offline fallback.
